set: kernel benchmark shared fixtures (experiment C, Task 100)
selection_note: 16 fixtures: 10 derived from upstream tests/oracle (provenance per case: upstream path + recipe SHA + license; expected values copied verbatim from upstream expected.json) and 6 self-authored (author/date stated; analytic expectations self-derived and shown in 'method'). The SAME parts are re-implemented twice: truck-side in harness/src/bin/w2_kernel.rs (direct kernel API, pinned SHA) and OCP-side in python/ocp_kernel_bench.py (cadquery-ocp 8.0.1.1.0 wheels in .ocp-venv).

tolerance.note: same defaults as upstream's oracle runner (REL_TOL 1e-3); truck measures tessellated geometry, OCCT integrates surfaces

provenance.cli_script_note: generated by the official release binary: solidcraft-cli recipe tests/oracle/01-box/recipe.json (tag v0.16.2 = 5de48e9, 80 commits behind the pin)

comparability.label: comparable
comparability.why: planar box; both kernels judged against the closed-form V=abc, A=2(ab+bc+ca)

expected.method: box 40 x 30 x 20 from the origin: V = abc, A = 2(ab + bc + ca)

provenance.cli_script_note: generated by the official release binary: solidcraft-cli recipe tests/oracle/02-cylinder/recipe.json (tag v0.16.2 = 5de48e9, 80 commits behind the pin)

comparability.label: comparable
comparability.why: analytic cylinder; truck measures through tessellation (upstream tolerance 1e-3 rel), OCCT integrates B-rep surfaces exactly

expected.method: cylinder r=15 h=50 on XY: V = pi r^2 h, A = 2 pi r^2 + 2 pi r h

provenance.cli_script_note: generated by the official release binary: solidcraft-cli recipe tests/oracle/04-revolve-vase/recipe.json (tag v0.16.2 = 5de48e9, 80 commits behind the pin)

comparability.label: approximately-comparable
comparability.why: same profile revolved 360 deg; kernels split the periodic surface at their own seams, so face counts and area can differ slightly while volume is judged against Pappus

expected.method: revolve of a line/3-point-arc profile (XZ, x = radius, z = -sketch y) 360 deg about Z. Pappus/Green: V = 2 pi * int x dA, z_c = int x z dA / int x dA, A = sum over profile edges of 2 pi int x ds (bottom disk r20, frustum r20->25, torus zone of the arc (centre (-16.000000, 33.000000), R=41.109610), frustum r15->18, top disk r18)

provenance.cli_script_note: generated by the official release binary: solidcraft-cli recipe tests/oracle/07-fillet-all-edges/recipe.json (tag v0.16.2 = 5de48e9, 80 commits behind the pin)

comparability.label: approximately-comparable

expected.method: box 40x30x20 with every edge rounded r=3 = inner box (34x24x14) grown by a ball r (Steiner): V = abc + 2r(ab+bc+ca) + pi r^2 (a+b+c) + 4/3 pi r^3, A = 2(ab+bc+ca) + 2 pi r (a+b+c) + 4 pi r^2; faces 6 planes + 12 quarter cylinders + 8 sphere octants

provenance.cli_script_note: generated by the official release binary: solidcraft-cli recipe tests/oracle/15-combine-intersect/recipe.json (tag v0.16.2 = 5de48e9, 80 commits behind the pin)

provenance.author: W2 lane-b kernel-benchmark worker (Task 100)
provenance.derived_from: same box parametrization as oracle 07 (tests/oracle/07-fillet-all-edges), subset of its edge set

comparability.label: approximately-comparable
comparability.why: straight-edge constant-radius subset (no corner patches where three blends meet): both kernels roll the same cylinder on the same edges; only end-cap trimming can differ

expected.method: box 40x30x20, fillet r=3 on the 4 vertical edges: cross-section = ab - (4-pi) r^2; V = cross*h; A = 2*cross + (2((a-2r)+(b-2r)) + 2 pi r) h

comparability.label: approximately-comparable
comparability.why: failure probe: fillet radius far larger than the geometry allows; a clear refusal is an honest outcome, recorded verbatim per kernel

expected.note: no analytic volume: the case must not build; record each kernel's outcome class and verbatim error
expected.method: stress case (author: W2 lane-b, 2026-10-20): fillet r=200 on box 40x30x20 all 12 edges (oracle 07 box)

comparability.label: approximately-comparable
comparability.why: near-tangency + body-split probe: cylinder wall pokes through two box faces by 0.0001 mm AND spans the full y-range, splitting the box into two lumps; totals judged analytically

expected.note: the r=5.0001 disk at (10,5) spans the box's full y-range [0,10] (poking through BOTH side faces by 0.0001 mm), so the cut SPLITS the box into two lumps (7 faces each, 14 total); each lump is near-tangent-trimmed on its inner face. Volume is the total over both lumps. Observed on truck first (shells=2), analytic confirmed after: no connection between the lumps at any y since the disk covers x in [10-sqrt(r^2-(y-5)^2), 10+sqrt(r^2-(y-5)^2)] with sqrt >= 0.0316 > 0 at y=0,10.
expected.method: box 20x10x10 cut cylinder r=5.0001 axis z at (10,5) spanning z -5..15: V = 2000 - 10*(pi r^2 - 2*seg), seg = r^2 acos(5/r) - 5*sqrt(r^2-25) (chord 5 from the axis)

comparability.label: approximately-comparable
comparability.why: sliver probe: 50 x 0.02 profile (aspect 2500:1) extruded 10 mm; both kernels must hold V = 10 exactly

expected.method: rectangle 50 x 0.02 extruded 10: V = a*b*c; A = 2*ab + 2(a+b)*c

comparability.label: approximately-comparable
comparability.why: coincident-face probe: two 10^3 boxes sharing the whole x=10 face; a correct union sews them into one 20x10x10 box (V=2000, faces 6)

comparability.label: approximately-comparable
